levels.name: THREE AGAINST THREE
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Three squads per side and no replacements. Six small mountain islands break up a broad plain; every supporting position costs a third of your army.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: THE LONG HOOK
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Crescent ridges shelter the direct approach. Fast Lenets and a Rabbit can take the long outside route, but the infantry must still reach a camp or arsenal.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: TWO COLORS OF STEEL
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Only Charlie and Bison exist here. A diagonal chain of islands makes positioning and mutual support the entire problem.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: DIVIDED WEIGHT
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Two large mountain formations divide the approach into three wide lanes. Your separated detachments can concentrate quickly only if you keep the middle passage usable.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: THE INVITING BOWL
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: A horseshoe of mountains wraps a tempting central arsenal. The straight road enters its mouth; the spacious outside flanks let the opponent approach its sides.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: RINGS WITHOUT WALLS
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Broken mountain atolls enclose useful staging areas. Several gaps make each enclosure permeable; a force inside must watch more than the entrance it used.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: NO HEAVY ANSWER
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Capturers and missile buggies only. Scattered small islands provide turning points for hit-and-retreat movement, with very little armor to absorb mistakes.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: FINGER COUNTRY
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Long mountain fingers project into open ground. Their tips are turning points, while gaps between the fingers shelter artillery and isolated detachments.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: A NARROW ADVANTAGE
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Two Giants give Union impressive local strength but few bodies. The hourglass formations invite a frontal stand while lighter forces can use the wide outer lanes.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: GUNS NEED COMPANY
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Offset mountain ribbons put neighboring lanes within artillery reach. Your gun-heavy army still needs infantry and a small mobile screen to occupy the ground.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: EMPTY MILES
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Four squads each on a very wide field. Elongated shoals interrupt pursuit; committing two units to one side leaves enormous areas unguarded.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: THE CROWN'S TEETH
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: A broken crown of mountains offers several protected approaches to the center. The gaps face different directions, so one supporting group cannot cover them all.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: DISTANT NEIGHBORS
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Two island clusters face each other across an open gulf. Pelicans can shift cargo across the gulf, while unsupported ground units spend several turns crossing it.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: THE BRIGHT ROAD
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: A conspicuous straight road passes through a crooked reef. Its speed comes with no terrain defense; the surrounding plain leaves room to approach on a wider frontage.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: MANY SMALL FRONTS
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: A loose field of irregular islands creates many small fronts. Four arsenals per side of the map reward local captures, but scattering every squad leaves no reserve.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.

levels.name: HORIZON CONVERGENCE
levels.author: AI-made by Codex
levels.description: Several island chains converge around a wide central gulf. Large mixed armies must choose where to concentrate while keeping distant factory approaches and their own camp covered.
levels.special: Capture the enemy camp or eliminate its eligible forces. No Hunters, Falcons or Eagles. Each battle starts with its own authored forces; units do not carry between missions.
